title: paspalidium flavidum
intro: Paspalidium flavidum, commonly known as yellow panic grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of P. flavidum include wound healing, reducing oxidative stress, and combating infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
